first.rationale: The two observed declines (activation -6%, onboarding completion -4%) are plausibly linked, with onboarding friction upstream of activation, so the highest-leverage single slot is the funnel fix rather than a price response. Memory_86 (shortened onboarding lifting completion and time-to-value) and memory_31 (signup field reduction lifting first-week activation) both point the same direction and are mutually corroborating, which is why I favor simplify_onboarding over activation_messaging (memory_91), though the latter is the close second and I am verifying it to see whether its week-one engagement lift was measured on the same accounts and whether it would be the better single lever if onboarding turns out not to be the binding constraint. I am verifying memory_86 specifically because it is the load-bearing claim for my chosen action and I want the original record's effect size, sample, and whether 'completion' was a proxy metric or tied to downstream qualified revenue. I am deliberately NOT choosing promotional_pricing despite the competitor's entry pricing being the most salient pressure: memory_73 records exactly this intervention working on acquisition and revenue while materially reducing 30-day retention, and carries an explicit instruction not to generalize it. The primary objective is sustainable long-term qualified revenue, so the memory's warning is directly on point and the competitive urgency is not new evidence against it. Downstream value risk: 'completion rate' and 'week-one engagement' are proxies that can be lifted by stripping qualifying friction, which may admit lower-intent accounts and inflate the metric while degrading qualified revenue and retention. I will require the experiment to read out on 30-day retention and qualified-pipeline quality, not completion alone. Uncertainty preserved: all memories predate the competitor's launch, so the incoming SMB population mix may have shifted and prior effect sizes may not transfer; the archive pulls may change my choice toward activation_messaging if memory_86's record is weaker than the summary implies.
